title: A Orbit for the Signal Again
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Tamsin Delacroix, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
